column1: # Everyday and chat Bulgarian for the glide and candidate engines: words a person types in a
# message that the AOSP corpus under-rates or lacks (благодаря sat at 37, чао and мерси were missing).
# Merged into bg.txt, and ru_bg.txt rebuilt after it, by
# --floor 0 keeps the list's long tail (its frequencies go down to 2). A boost only raises or adds.
# The list is flat at the top (4,516 words at 255), so the tiers are 255 greetings and replies,
# 230 messaging verbs, time words, chat, apps and tech, 210 colloquialisms, short slang and
# everyday nouns. Lowercase letters only, no names, no obscene words.
